transcription.notes: Triple is the only encoding here that survives polyphony, so this file carries both hands. The left hand is a quarter rest then a half chord in bars 1-7; bar 8 is a quarter G7 then a half C. Rests are not written: triple records start times, so silence is already implied. Harmony read off the page: C, G7, G7, C, C7, F, C, G7-C — which matches the printed chord symbols C, G7, C over bars 1, 2 and 4.
transcription.spelling: Bar 5's chord is engraved E3 A#3 C4. A# is the sharp spelling of Bb, so the chord is C7, and it resolves to the F in bar 6.
transcription.tempo_note: The page carries no tempo mark. 120 is a guess and affects playback only.
